source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 4 (North Down results, continuing "Sion tops the poll"); Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8 ("Sion tops the poll: rural elections with 96 pc")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names, labels, votes and majority read on the page image of the Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 4 (North Down paragraph): McDowell (Ind.) 261, McKee (U.) 237, majority 24, 70 pc poll.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were contested; the results printed here are those whose figures were legible. The remaining unopposed returns were not printed in the reports used here. Sitting member held the seat by 24 votes; 70 pc poll.
correctionNote: Corrected from the page image of Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 4 (council-audit, Nov 2026): William McDowell's vote 281 -> 261 (the printed majority of 24 over McKee's 237 proves it); the citation now names p. 4, where the North Down results are printed.
